description: Replacement of existing windows to the rear and side elevation with a balustrade to the first floor rear window, installation of louvres to rear gable window, replacement of roof tiles, infilling of six side windows and side two doors, creation of two side window openings, alterations to front boundary and creation of pedestrian gate access, installation of a letterbox, alterations to front garden including new planting areas and paving, creation of decking area and planters in rear garden of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & access statement, tree survey, Flood Risk Assessment, A-1000, A-1005, A-1102, A1100, A1101, A1211, A1220, A-1221, A-1311, A-1110, A-1111, A-1210, A1310, A1301, A1103, A-1112, A-1302, A-1312 Received: 13/05/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No development to the roof of the building shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the roof of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
